entities.name: Juan Lechín Oquendo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Lechín Oquendo was a Bolivian politician and trade unionist who served as executive secretary of the Bolivian Workers' Center from 1952 to 1987. He also served as minister of mining from 1952 to 1954 and as the 29th vice president of Bolivia from 1960 to 1964.
